*Advisors: Prof. Malini Balakrishnan, Prof. Prashanth Kumar* | Jan 2025 – May 2026

## Overview

This project developed and analyzed the efficiency of algal photobioreactors to evaluate their energy-saving potential as building facades, combining simulation, wet-lab experimentation, and life-cycle assessment.

## Key Contributions

- Developed and analyzed efficiency of **algal photobioreactors** to evaluate energy-saving potential.
- Ran **15+ building-energy simulations** varying facade parameters with DesignBuilder software to model performance.
- Cultured algae and carried out media preparation, inoculation, sampling, and growth-curve analysis to characterize algal growth.
- Designed and operated a lab scale photobioreactor to **experimentally validate algal growth and nutrient absorption**.
- Conducted **life-cycle assessment (LCA)** using OpenLCA to evaluate environmental impacts of the algal facade vs blinds.
- Found energy savings value of up to **-20 Global Warming Potential** units for facade operation.

## Publication

**Bansal, A.**, Mathai, B., Jadhav, N., Balakrishnan, M., Kumar, P. S. (2025). ***Designing an Algal Façade for Improving Energy Efficiency in a Building in North India***. Oral presentation at the X International Conference on Sustainable Energy and Environmental Challenges (X SEEC).
